name: xkcd_panel
about: a small xkcd comic between pages: the screen goes dark with its alt text, the comic prints in, then the new page comes down over it

licence.assets: none in the repo. The comics are fetched from xkcd.com: Randall Munroe's, CC BY-NC 2.5, credited on screen
licence.notes: MIT, running in the OCL v1.1 + SWAtt v1 engine. xkcd's licence is non-commercial: fine on our own kiosks, not on one run for profit
